title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person violating this part shall be fined not less than $25 nor more than $500, or imprisoned not more than one month, or both.
bodyHtml: §264-77  Penalty.  Any person violating this part shall be fined not less than $25 nor more than $500, or imprisoned not more than one month, or both. [L 1966, c 45, pt of §2; HRS §264-77]
